name: The House of Magic 2013
plot: يجد ثاندر، القط الصغير المهجور الذي يبحث عن مأوى من عاصفة، نفسه في منزل غريب للغاية، يملكه ساحر عجوز وتسكنه مجموعة مذهلة من الآلات والأدوات. لا يرحب الجميع بانضمامه الجديد إلى المجموعة، إذ يتآمر جاك رابيت وماغي ماوس لطرد ثاندر. ويزداد الوضع سوءًا عندما يُنقل الساحر إلى المستشفى، ويرى ابن أخيه الماكر فرصته للاستفادة من بيع القصر. بطلنا الصغير مصمم على إثبات جدارته، فيستعين ببعض مساعدي الساحر غريبي الأطوار لحماية منزله السحري الجديد.

name: Penguins of Madagascar 2014
plot: يتحد كل من سكيبر وكوالسكي وريكو وبرايفت مع منظمة \\\"الريح الشمالية\\\" السرية لإيقاف الدكتور أوكتافيوس براين الشرير من تدمير العالم كما نعرفه.

name: Corpse Bride 2005
plot: في قرية أوروبية من القرن التاسع عشر، يتم نقل شاب على وشك الزواج إلى العالم السفلي ويتزوج من عروس جثة غامضة، بينما تنتظره عروسه الحقيقية حزينة في عالم الأحياء.

name: Minions 2015
plot: يتم تجنيد التوابع ستيوارت وكيفن وبوب من قبل سكارليت أوفركيل، وهي شريرة خارقة، والتي تقوم، إلى جانب زوجها المخترع هيرب، بوضع مؤامرة للسيطرة على العالم.

name: Despicable Me 3 2017 مترجم
plot: يجب على غرو وزوجته لوسي منع نجم الطفولة السابق في الثمانينيات، بالتازار برات، من تحقيق الهيمنة العالمية.

name: Despicable Me 2 2013 مترجم
plot: تم تجنيد غرو من قبل رابطة مكافحة الأشرار للمساعدة في التعامل مع مجرم خارق جديد قوي.

name: Minions & Monsters 2026
plot: هذه هي القصة الصاخبة والمضحكة والحقيقية تمامًا عن كيفية غزو المينيونز لهوليوود، وكيف أصبحوا نجومًا سينمائيين، وخسروا كل شيء، وأطلقوا العنان للوحوش على العالم، ثم تكاتفوا معًا لمحاولة إنقاذ الكوكب من الفوضى التي أحدثوها للتو.

name: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender 2026
plot: يتعرف أفاتار آنغ، آخر مُسخِّر للهواء في العالم، على قوة قديمة قد تُنقذ حضارته من الانقراض. وبمساعدة أصدقائه، ينطلق في رحلة عالمية للعثور عليها قبل أن تقع في الأيدي الخطأ وتُهدد بتقويض السلام الذي ضحوا بكل شيء من أجله.

name: Boonie Bears: The Hidden Protector 2026
plot: بعد أن اكتسب أبطالنا قوى سحرية من نيان، وحش العام الأسطوري، انتقلوا إلى عالم سحري لإيقاف أزمة تهدد بنهاية العالم. يواجه بريار فقدان مكانته كأخ أكبر بعد أن اكتسب الآخرون قوى، مما يقوده إلى التورط في مؤامرة تهدد عالمي البشر والخالدين على حد سواء.

name: Toy Story 5 2026
plot: عندما تتلقى بوني جهازًا لوحيًا من نوع ليليباد كهدية وتصبح مهووسة به، تصبح مهام باز ووودي وجيسي وبقية أفراد العصابة أصعب بشكل كبير عندما يضطرون إلى مواجهة التهديد الجديد لوقت اللعب.

name: Riverdance: The Animated Adventure 2021 مدبلج
plot: يخوض فتى أيرلندي صغير يُدعى كيغان وفتاة إسبانية تُدعى مويا رحلةً إلى عالمٍ سحريٍّ يسكنه ميغالوسيروس جيجانتيوس، حيث يُعلّمانهما تقدير فن ريفر دانس كاحتفالٍ بالحياة. الفيلم مُقتبسٌ من العرض المسرحي الشهير الذي يحمل الاسم نفسه، ويضمّ موسيقى بيل ويلان الحائزة على جوائز غرامي البلاتينية المتعددة.

name: Toy Story 3 2010 مدبلج
plot: لم يلعب أحد بألعاب وودي وباز وبقية ألعاب آندي منذ سنوات. ومع اقتراب موعد التحاق آندي بالجامعة، يجد الأصدقاء أنفسهم بالخطأ في مركز رعاية نهارية مشبوه. يجب على الألعاب أن تتحد للهروب والعودة إلى آندي.

name: Toy Story 4 2019 مدبلج
plot: لطالما كان وودي واثقًا من مكانته في العالم، ومخلصًا لرعاية طفله - سواء كان آندي أو بوني. ولكن بعد أن ابتكرت بوني لعبة جديدة مترددة تُدعى \\\"فوركي\\\"، تُشكّل رحلة برية مليئة بالمغامرات برفقة أصدقاء قدامى وجدد تحديًا لكل ما يؤمن به وودي حول الولاء والغاية، وما يعنيه حقًا أن تكون لعبة.

name: The Breadwinner 2017
plot: فتاة صغيرة عنيدة في أفغانستان، التي يحكمها طالبان، تتنكر في زي صبي من أجل إعالة أسرتها.

name: Toy Story 1 1995 مدبلج
plot: بقيادة وودي، تعيش ألعاب آندي بسعادة في غرفته حتى يأتي عيد ميلاده ويُدخل باز لايت يير إلى المشهد. خوفًا من فقدان مكانته في قلب آندي، يُدبّر وودي مكيدة ضد باز. ولكن عندما تُفرّق الظروف بين باز ووودي ومالكهما، يتعلم الثنائي في النهاية أن يتجاوزا خلافاتهما.

name: The Angry Birds Movie 1 - 2016
plot: جزيرةٌ يسكنها بالكامل، أو يكاد، طيورٌ سعيدةٌ لا تطير. في هذه الجنة، لطالما كان ريد، الطائر سريع الغضب، وتشاك السريع، وبومب المتقلب المزاج، غرباء. ولكن عندما تزور الجزيرة خنازير خضراء غامضة، يقع على عاتق هؤلاء المنبوذين غير المتوقعين مهمة كشف نوايا هذه الخنازير.

name: Ratatouille مدبلج
plot: يتمتع ريمي، وهو فأر، بذوق رفيع يفوق بكثير ذوق رفاقه. يحلم بأن يصبح طاهياً، طاهياً مبدعاً لا جامعاً للنفايات. عندما يرميه القدر في مجاري الصرف الصحي أسفل أحد أشهر مطاعم باريس، يجد نفسه في موقع مثالي لتحقيق حلمه. يُقيم ريمي تحالفاً غير مألوف مع عامل مطبخ شاب بائس، ويبدأ حياة مزدوجة جريئة في عالم الطهي. وبينما يسعى ريمي لتحقيق رؤيته، عليه أن يتجاوز شكوك رئيس الطهاة سكينر المُتلاعب، واستياء مستعمرته، وحضور ناقد الطعام الشهير أنطون إيغو، الذي يُثير الرعب في قلوب الطهاة في جميع أنحاء فرنسا.

name: Animal Farm 2025
plot: تثور مجموعة من حيوانات المزرعة على مالكها المهمل، حالمةً بالمساواة والحرية. ولكن مع سيطرة الخنازير، تتحول الثورة إلى استبداد، حيث تُشوّه الحقائق وتُقمع المعارضة.

name: Pokemon: The Mastermind of Mirage Pokemon 2006
plot: تدور أحداث قصة \\\"العقل المدبر لبوكيمون السراب\\\" حول عالم بوكيمون طور نظام سراب جديدًا لإحياء البوكيمونات المنقرضة. يصل ساتوشي وهاروكا وماساتو وتاكيشي إلى قصر السراب لمشاهدة عرض توضيحي لهذا الجهاز الجديد، ليشهدوا اختطاف العالم! ثم يظهر غريب غامض ويدّعي أن الجهاز قادر بالفعل على خلق بوكيمونات بلا نقاط ضعف. يقع على عاتق ساتوشي ورفاقه الحفاظ على التوازن الطبيعي لعالم البوكيمون.

name: Pokemon: Destiny Deoxys 2004
plot: ديوكسيس، وهو بوكيمون من الفضاء الخارجي، يرهب المدينة عالية التقنية التي يزورها آش كيتشوم وأصدقاؤه.

name: Pokemon: Jirachi - Wish Maker 2003
plot: يصادف آش وماي وبروك وماكس مهرجان نجمة الأمنيات لسبع ليالٍ. وبينما هم يستمتعون، ينزل البوكيمون الأسطوري جيراتشي من السماء ويصادق ماكس. جيراتشي، الذي يمتلك القدرة على تحقيق أي أمنية، مطلوب بشدة من قبل الكثيرين الذين يرغبون في الحصول على قوته. يسعى رجل إلى استخدام قوته الأسطورية لإحياء بوكيمون قديم يُعرف باسم جراودون، غير مدرك للمخاطر الكامنة في قدرات جيراتشي.

name: Pokemon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew 2005
plot: في الماضي الأسطوري، قبل اختراع كرات البوكيمون، استشعر بوكيمون بطلٌ يُدعى لوكاريو، مُوجِّهٌ بالهالة، جيشين على وشك الاصطدام، وخطر حربٍ طاحنةٍ أمام قلعة أولدوران في كانتو لن تُبقي على أحد. نقل لوكاريو هذه الرسالة إلى سيده، البطل الأسطوري آرلون، بينما كان يتعرض لهجومٍ من مجموعةٍ شرسةٍ من الهيلغار. خلال المعركة، فقد لوكاريو بصره، ولم يعد قادرًا على الرؤية. استخدم لوكاريو حاسة استشعار هالته، وباستخدام قنبلة الموجة الهجومية، قضى عليهم. لكن أمام هذا التهديد، كانت ملكة روتا، السيدة رين، مُصممةً على الموت مع شعبها، فاتخذ آرلون قراره.

name: Pokemon 4Ever - Celebi - Voice of the Forest 2001
plot: للهرب من صياد بوكيمون جشع، يجب على سيليبي استخدام آخر ما تبقى لديه من طاقة للسفر عبر الزمن إلى يومنا هذا. يصطحب سيليبي معه سامي، الصبي الذي كان يحاول حمايته. برفقة آش وبيكاتشو وبقية المجموعة، يواجه سامي وسيليبي عدوًا أكثر تطورًا من الصياد، ومصير الغابة معلق على المحك.

name: Pokemon Heroes 2002
plot: يحاول آش وبيكاتشو وبقية الأصدقاء إيقاف لصين يختبئان في قنوات وأزقة ألتوماري، عاصمة المياه العريقة. وينضم إلى المغامرة اثنان من البوكيمونات الأسطورية الجديدة، وهما شقيقان يُدعيان لاتياس ولاتيوس، ويعملان كحارسين للسلام وحامين لندى الروح - وهو كنز لا يُقدر بثمن ذو قوة غامضة.

name: Barnyard 2006
plot: أوتيس بقرة هولشتاين مرحة ومشاكسة تعيش في مزرعة، حيث تتصرف الحيوانات، دون علم البشر، كبشر. يفضل أوتيس اللهو مع أصدقائه المقربين: الفأر بيب، وابن عرس فريدي، والديك بيك، والخنزير بيغ، بدلاً من اتباع القواعد الصارمة وتحمل المسؤولية. هذا الأمر يزعج والده بالتبني بن، قائد مجتمع المزرعة، الذي يتسم بالصرامة. في إحدى الأمسيات، يقنع أوتيس بن بتغطية نوبته الليلية ليتمكن من حضور حفلة ضخمة في الحظيرة وإثارة إعجاب ديزي، البقرة الحامل التي وصلت حديثًا إلى المزرعة مع صديقتها المقربة بيسي. وبينما تحتفل الحيوانات، يحاول داغ الذئب وقطيعه مهاجمة قن الدجاج. يصدهم بن وحده، لكنه يُصاب بجروح قاتلة ويُقتل. الآن، يجب على أوتيس أن يتعلم قيمة المسؤولية عندما يصبح قائدًا لمجتمع مزرعته.

name: في كل جسد حكاية مدبلج
plot: يتبادل مخلوق ضئيل من سكان الغابة جسده فجأة مع أنثى طير مهيبة، فيتعين عليهما التعاون معًا للنجاة في أكبر مغامرات حياتهما.

name: Swapped 2026
plot: مخلوق صغير يعيش في الغابة وطائر مهيب، عدوان لدودان في الوادي، يتبادلان الأدوار بطريقة سحرية وينطلقان في مغامرة العمر للعودة إلى وضعهما الطبيعي. سرعان ما تكشف رحلتهما عن تهديد أكبر، تهديد قد لا يعرض للخطر نوعهما فحسب، بل الوادي بأكمله الذي يعتبرانه موطنهما.

name: 10 Lives
plot: A pampered cat takes for granted the lucky hand he has been dealt after he is rescued and loved by Rose, a kind-hearted and passionate student. When he loses his ninth life, fate steps in to set him on a transformative journey.

name: 30,000 ميل تحت سطح البحر - قصص عالمية
A Bug \'s Life 1998
plot: On behalf of "oppressed bugs everywhere," an inventive ant named Flik hires a troupe of warrior bugs to defend his bustling colony from a horde of freeloading grasshoppers led by the evil-minded Hopper.

name: Adventures of Dally and Spanky - 2019
plot: A girl inherits a miniature horse that develops an unlikely friendship with her half-sister's Jack Russell Terrier, who takes to riding on the horse's back.

name: A Go! Go! Cory Carson Halloween - 2020
plot: Cory, Chrissy and Freddie are on the hunt for king-sized candy bars this Halloween! But are all the treats worth the trek to the spooky side of town?

name: A Hedgehog \'s Visit - 2014
plot: A grumpy hedgehog trying to confess his love. Will he be able to overcome his insecurities? The struggle with fear as a short film.

name: Aladdin and the Wonderful Lamp - 1934
plot: Aladdin is a child laborer who works for a guy that exchanges "new lamps for old". This guy swaps a "new" lamp for 2-3 replacement old lamps, then brings back the old lamps for Aladdin to polish and make look like new. One day Aladdin sees a princess riding by as he looks out the window, and he falls for her. But then he must return to his lamp polishing...

name: Alien Xmas - 2020
plot: A young elf mistakes a tiny alien for a Christmas gift, not knowing her new plaything has plans to destroy Earth's gravity — and steal all the presents.

name: Al Maht
plot: Based on the successful social series, “Al Maht” revolves around a struggling high school graduate in choosing his destiny.

name: America  The Motion Picture - 2021
plot: A chainsaw-wielding George Washington teams with beer-loving bro Sam Adams to take down the Brits in a tongue-in-cheek riff on the American Revolution.

name: Anastasia - 1997
plot: Ten years after she was separated from her family, an eighteen-year-old orphan with vague memories of the past sets out to Paris in hopes of reuniting with her grandmother. She is accompanied by two con men, who intend to pass her off as the Grand Duchess Anastasia to the Dowager Empress for a reward.

name: An Extremely Goofy Movie 2000
plot: It's all extreme sports and a life of freedom as Max sets off for college -- but Goofy misses Max so much he loses his job and goes to finish college alongside Max and his friends. But as Goofy tries to get closer to Max, both must go to the extreme to learn how to live their own lives together.
director: Douglas McCarthy, Abeth de la Cruz

name: Animal Crackers - 2017
plot: A family must use a magical box of Animal Crackers to save a rundown circus from being taken over by their evil uncle Horatio P. Huntington.

name: Apollo 10½  A Space Age Childhood - 2022
plot: A man narrates stories of his life as a 10-year-old boy in 1969 Houston, weaving tales of nostalgia with a fantastical account of a journey to the moon.

name: AR Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy
Astro Boy - 2009
plot: Set in the futuristic Metro City, Astro Boy (Atom) is a young robot with incredible powers created by a brilliant scientist in the image of the son he had lost. Unable to fulfill his creator's expectations, Astro embarks on a journey in search of acceptance, experiencing betrayal and a netherworld of robot gladiators, before returning to save Metro City and reconcile with the father who rejected him.

name: Atlantis  The Lost Empire
plot: A young linguist named Milo Thatch joins an intrepid group of explorers to find the mysterious lost continent of Atlantis.

name: A Trash Truck Christmas - 2020
plot: When Santa crash-lands in the junkyard on Christmas Eve, Hank, Trash Truck and their animal friends all have a hand in rescuing the holiday for everyone.

name: Back to Gaya - 2004
plot: The beautiful world of Gaya is home to two similar humanoid species: Zeldons who are the furry majority residents, and Snurks, who are goblin-like outcasts. But suddenly all Gayans are facing imminent danger when a magic stone which protects their world, "the Dalamite", is beamed away by a mysterious force. Three Snurks immediately go after it, hoping to be the heroes for once. They are shortly followed by some standout Zeldons: Zino the trouble-prone popular guy & his sidekick, clever but somewhat cowardly inventor Boo, as well as rebel princess Alanta. Their journey ends up leading them all on a dangerous interdimensional quest to find the stone, while they must also figure out a way to get back to Gaya.

name: Back to the Outback - 2021
plot: Tired of being locked in a reptile house where humans gawk at them like they are monsters, a ragtag group of Australia’s deadliest creatures plot an escape from their zoo to the Outback, a place where they’ll fit in without being judged.

name: Back to the Outback - 2021
plot: Tired of being locked in a reptile house where humans gawk at them like they are monsters, a ragtag group of Australia’s deadliest creatures plot an escape from their zoo to the Outback, a place where they’ll fit in without being judged.

name: Bambi 1942
plot: Bambi's tale unfolds from season to season as the young prince of the forest learns about life, love, and friends.

name: Barbie and the Secret Door - 2014
plot: A shy princess discovers a secret door in her kingdom and enters a magical world full of magical creatures. She meets a mermaid and a fairy who tell her about a spoiled ruler threatening them.

name: Barbie  Big City, Big Dreams - 2021
plot: Barbie meets another Barbie Roberts, forming a close friendship, nicknaming each other Malibu and Brooklyn when they both attend the Handlers, Performing Art School in NYC, over the summer, competing for a spot at the spotlight solo.

name: Barbie  Dolphin Magic - 2017
plot: Barbie and her sisters take off on another exciting, global adventure to visit their friend Ken at his summer internship at a beautiful and exotic coral reef.

name: Barbie  Dreamtopia Festival of Fun - 2018
plot: With their friends, Chelsea and Barbie take us on a fantastical journey, embarking on amazing adventures and exploring new lands full of limitless possibilities.

name: Barbie in the Nutcracker - 2001
plot: The Mouse King casts an evil spell over Clara that causes her to shrink. Clara and the Nutcracker set out on an adventurous journey to find Sugarplum Princess, who has the power to undo the spell.

name: Beat Bugs  All Together Now - 2017
plot: After winning a local talent show, the Beat Bugs journey to compete on "The Bug Factor," a televised singing contest held in faraway Rocket Ship Park.

name: Belle and Sebastian - 2013
plot: Belle and Sebastian is set high in the snowy Alps during the Second World War. The resourceful Sebastian is a lonely boy who tames and befriends a giant, wild mountain dog, Belle – even though the villagers believe her to be ‘the beast’ that has been killing their sheep.

name: Ben 10  Race Against Time - 2008
plot: Ben, Gwen, and Max must stop an extraterrestrial who plans to open a gateway that leads to an alien invasion.

name: Ben 10  Secret of the Omnitrix - 2007
plot: After a battle with Dr. Animo in a power plant, Ben notices something strange is happening with the Omnitrix but doesn't tell anyone. Tetrax arrives and tells them the Omnitrix is broadcasting a self-destruct signal. Tetrax and Ben go to find the creator of the Omnitrix to fix it before it destroys itself and the universe along with it. Gwen stows away to help her cousin.

name: Ben 10 vs  the Universe  The Movie - 2020
plot: A blast from Ben's past returns to do double the damage on Team Tennyson and planet Earth itself, forcing Ben to go interstellar to save the day. Based on the 2016 reboot.

name: Bobbleheads  The Movie - 2020
plot: Get ready for a big shake-up when misfit bobbleheads take on trashy humans and a slobbery dog who crash their home with plans to swap a new baseball player bobblehead for a valuable one of them. With some guidance from Bobblehead Cher, they find the courage to bobble-up for an outrageous battle of wits and wobble.

name: Bolt
plot: Bolt is the star of the biggest show in Hollywood. The only problem is, he thinks it's real. After he's accidentally shipped to New York City and separated from Penny, his beloved co-star and owner, Bolt must harness all his "super powers" to find a way home.

name: Boonie Bears  The Wild Life
plot: Bear brothers Briar and Bramble set off on an adventure with their human friend Vick to Wild Land, an amusement park where humans can turn into animals using a gene-technology bracelet.

name: Brother Bear
plot: When an impulsive boy named Kenai is magically transformed into a bear, he must literally walk in another's footsteps until he learns some valuable life lessons. His courageous and often zany journey introduces him to a forest full of wildlife, including the lovable bear cub Koda, hilarious moose Rutt and Tuke, woolly mammoths and rambunctious rams.

name: Brother Bear 2 2006
plot: Kenai finds his childhood human friend Nita and the two embark on a journey to burn the amulet he gave to her before he was a bear, much to Koda's dismay.

name: Buzz Lightyof Star Command The Adventure Begins 2000
Cars 2
plot: Star race car Lightning McQueen and his pal Mater head overseas to compete in the World Grand Prix race. But the road to the championship becomes rocky as Mater gets caught up in an intriguing adventure of his own: international espionage.

name: Cars 3 2017
plot: Blindsided by a new generation of blazing-fast racers, the legendary Lightning McQueen is suddenly pushed out of the sport he loves. To get back in the game, he will need the help of an eager young race technician with her own plan to win, inspiration from the late Fabulous Hudson Hornet, and a few unexpected turns.

name: Cars 2006
plot: Lightning McQueen, a hotshot rookie race car driven to succeed, discovers that life is about the journey, not the finish line, when he finds himself unexpectedly detoured in the sleepy Route 66 town of Radiator Springs. On route across the country to the big Piston Cup Championship in California to compete against two seasoned pros, McQueen gets to know the town's offbeat characters.

name: Checkered Ninja 2 - 2021
plot: After Phillip Eppermint manages to evade a prison sentence in Thailand, Checkered Ninja comes alive and seeks out Alex. Together, with Alex and his entire family, they now have to go to Thailand to bust Eppermint.

name: Cinderella II  Dreams Come True - 2002
plot: As a newly crowned princess, Cinderella quickly learns that life at the Palace - and her royal responsibilities - are more challenging than she had imagined. In three heartwarming tales, Cinderella calls on her animal friends and her Fairy Godmother to help as she brings her own grace and charm to her regal role and discovers that being true to yourself is the best way to make your dreams come true.

name: Cinderella III  A Twist in Time - 2007
plot: When Lady Tremaine steals the Fairy Godmother's wand and changes history, it's up to Cinderella to restore the timeline and reclaim her prince.

name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs - 2009
plot: Inventor Flint Lockwood creates a machine that makes clouds rain food, enabling the down-and-out citizens of Chewandswallow to feed themselves. But when the falling food reaches gargantuan proportions, Flint must scramble to avert disaster. Can he regain control of the machine and put an end to the wild weather before the town is destroyed?

name: Coco 2017
plot: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.

name: Coraline
plot: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, 11-year-old Coraline discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life. In order to stay in the fantasy, she must make a frighteningly real sacrifice.

name: DC Super Hero Girls  Legends of Atlantis - 2018
plot: Siren steals the Book of Legends in order to locate the Trident of Atlantis and rule the entire ocean.

name: Demon Slayer  Kimetsu no Yaiba ON STAGE - 2023
plot: A special stage program celebrating the series of the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba anime. This stage program is a live capture and features cast members who bring the series' world to life, as they perform an exclusive live reading of an original story and a special live dubbing performance.

name: Descendants 2
plot: When the pressure to be royal becomes too much for Mal, she returns to the Isle of the Lost where her archenemy Uma, Ursula's daughter, has taken her spot as self-proclaimed queen.

name: Despicable Me 1 2010 مترجم
plot: Gru is a supervillain determined to prove he’s the greatest by stealing the Moon. To pull off his plan, he adopts three orphaned girls—Margo, Edith, and Agnes—intending to use them as part of his scheme. However, as Gru bonds with the girls, his cold, villainous exterior begins to melt.

name: Detective Conan  The Scarlet Alibi - 2021
plot: Compilation film combining footage from various television anime episodes that center on the Akai family.

name: Dia of the Dead - 2019
plot: t's the Mexican Day of the Dead, and little Chiqui misses his mama terribly! Two years ago, she left home in the middle of the night to journey to The Beyond, a phantasmagoric land of the dead, which hosts an annual talent show to crown the Greatest Singer Beyond the Beyond - and Chiqui's mama, Julieta, is a luchadora with a dream, to become the most renowned singer ever! Determined to dance with his mama during her performance, young Chiqui sets out with his Papa Diego, the hulking luchador, to find The Beyond himself, and help put his familia back together!

name: Diary of a Wimpy Kid 2021
plot: Greg Heffley is a scrawny but ambitious kid with an active imagination and big plans to be rich and famous – he just has to survive middle school first.

name: Diary of a Wimpy Kid  Rodrick Rules - 2022
plot: As a new school year begins, Greg is subject to relentless teasing from his brother Rodrick. Will Greg manage to get along with him? Or will a secret ruin everything?

Dragon Rider - 2020
plot: An unlikely trio of heroes – a dragon, a boy and a forest brownie – embark on an epic adventure to find the “Rim of Heaven” - the mythological safe haven for all dragons.

name: Dragons  Rescue Riders  Secrets of the Songwing - 2020
plot: When a musical dragon with a beautiful voice hypnotizes the dragons and people of Huttsgalor, the Rescue Riders have to find a way to break the spell.

name: Duck Duck Goose - 2018
plot: After he’s grounded by an injury, a high-flying bachelor is saddled with two wide-eyed orphans as they come face-to-face with the dangers and beauty of the outside world.

name: Elemental - 2023
plot: In a city where fire, water, land and air residents live together, a fiery young woman and a go-with-the-flow guy will discover something elemental: how much they have in common.

name: Elena and the Secret of Avalor - 2016
plot: In the Kingdom of Avalor, Elena takes Naomi up a mountain to show her favorite view of the kingdom. Elena laments to Naomi how she was trapped in the Amulet of Avalor for forty-one years, and then presents to her a broken wand. She tells her that it was Shuriki's wand and how she would still be trapped in the Amulet if it was not for a brave young Princess: Sofia. Elena then proceeds to tell Naomi the whole story ...

name: Ella and the Little Sorcerer - 2021
plot: When Prince Alex is trapped in the body of a mouse, Ella and her friends set off on a journey to find the magic potion ingredients that can change him back. On a quest that tests fate itself, they discover that friendship is the most potent cure of all.

name: Ella Bella Bingo - 2020
plot: Ella Bella Bingo and Henry are best friends, but one day a new boy moves into the neighbourhood and everything changes.

name: Fantastic Journey to Oz - 2017
plot: The cunning and wicked Urfin wants to become ruler of Magic Land. With an army of wooden soldiers, he captures the Emerald City and renames it ti Urfinville. He is all but ready to celebrate victory, when his plans are ruined by an ordinary girl named Dorothy, who arrives in Magic Land just at the right time. She must return home, but not before she helps her friends - the Scarecrow, the Tin Man, and new-brave Lion - defeat Urfin. And in order to do that, they need to find out who he really is.

name: Fanzo Movie 2024
plot: Bashaar, a gift delivery worker, enters the VR world of FANZO, befriends the Fanzo gang, and faces the villain Dajoor. When Dajoor escapes into reality, Bashaar, with his sister Zainah, must stop him and protect their new friends.

name: Ferdinand - 2017
plot: Ferdinand, a little bull, prefers sitting quietly under a cork tree just smelling the flowers versus jumping around, snorting, and butting heads with other bulls. As Ferdinand grows big and strong, his temperament remains mellow. But one day five men come to choose the "biggest, fastest, roughest bull" for the bullfights in Madrid— and Ferdinand is mistakenly chosen.

name: Finding Dory 2016
plot: Dory is reunited with her friends Nemo and Marlin in the search for answers about her past. What can she remember? Who are her parents? And where did she learn to speak Whale?

name: Finding Nemo 2003
plot: Nemo, an adventurous young clownfish, is unexpectedly taken from his Great Barrier Reef home to a dentist's office aquarium. It's up to his worrisome father Marlin and a friendly but forgetful fish Dory to bring Nemo home -- meeting vegetarian sharks, surfer dude turtles, hypnotic jellyfish, hungry seagulls, and more along the way.

name: Godzilla  City on the Edge of Battle - 2018
plot: Humanity's desperate battle to reclaim the Earth from Godzilla continues. The key to defeating the King of the Monsters may be Mechagodzilla, a robotic weapon thought to have been lost nearly 20,000 years ago.

name: Guillermo del Toro \'s Pinocchio - 2022
plot: During the rise of fascism in Mussolini's Italy, a wooden boy brought magically to life struggles to live up to his father's expectations.

name: Happily N \'Ever After - 2007
plot: An alliance of evil-doers, led by Frieda, looks to take over Fairy Tale Land. But when Ella realizes her stepmother is out to ruin her storybook existence, she takes a dramatic turn and blossoms into the leader of the resistance effort.

name: Happy Halloween, Scooby-Doo! - 2020
plot: Scooby-Doo and the gang team up with their pals, Bill Nye The Science Guy and Elvira Mistress of the Dark, to solve this mystery of gigantic proportions and save Crystal Cove!

name: Heavenly Sword - 2014
plot: The film's plot follows that of the game closely. Nariko, a member of an ancient tribe who have guarded an ancient magical sword for thousands of years, is charged with bringing the sword to its destined wielder, a deity reincarnated who will bring peace to the land. But on her quest, Nariko must wield the sword herself against the forces of King Bohan, who wishes to possess the weapon himself.

name: Hellboy Animated  Sword of Storms - 2006
plot: A folklore professor becomes unwittingly possessed by the ancient Japanese demons of Thunder and Lightning. But when The Bureau of Paranormal Research & Defense dispatches a team of agents to investigate, a cursed samurai sword sends Hellboy to a supernatural dimension of ghosts, monsters, and feudal mayhem. Now while pyrokinetic Liz Sherman and fishboy Abe Sapien battle one very pissed-off dragon, a lost and cranky Hellboy must find his way home.

name: Henchmen
plot: When a new recruit joins the Union of Evil, he is assigned to a motley crew of blue-collar workers led by fallen henchmen Hank. But when “The Kid” accidentally steals the ultimate weapon, Hank must break his “risk nothing” code to save the boy he’s befriended, even if it means becoming the one thing he has always avoided… being a hero.

name: Hey Arnold! The Jungle Movie - 2018
plot: When their trip to San Lorenzo takes a turn for the worst, Arnold and his classmate’s only hope of getting home is retracing the dangerous path that led to Arnold's parents' disappearance.

name: Hop
plot: E.B., the Easter Bunny's teenage son, heads to Hollywood, determined to become a drummer in a rock 'n' roll band. In L.A., he's taken in by Fred after the out-of-work slacker hits E.B. with his car.

name: Horus  Prince of the Sun - 1968
plot: Young Horus lives in a mythical Scandinavia of the Iron Age. Recovering the stolen Sword of the Sun from a rock giant, he learns he must travel to the lands of his ancestors, encountering the beautiful but enigmatic Hilda as his journey leads to a series of adventures.

name: Hotel Transylvania 2 - 2015
plot: When the old-old-old-fashioned vampire Vlad arrives at the hotel for an impromptu family get-together, Hotel Transylvania is in for a collision of supernatural old-school and modern day cool.

name: Hotel Transylvania  Transformania - 2022
plot: When Van Helsing's mysterious invention, the "Monsterfication Ray," goes haywire, Drac and his monster pals are all transformed into humans, and Johnny becomes a monster. In their new mismatched bodies, Drac and Johnny must team up and race across the globe to find a cure before it's too late, and before they drive each other crazy.

name: How to Train Your Dragon - 2010
plot: As the son of a Viking leader on the cusp of manhood, shy Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III faces a rite of passage: he must kill a dragon to prove his warrior mettle. But after downing a feared dragon, he realizes that he no longer wants to destroy it, and instead befriends the beast – which he names Toothless – much to the chagrin of his warrior father.

name: How to Train Your Dragon
plot: On the rugged isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been bitter enemies for generations, Hiccup stands apart, defying centuries of tradition when he befriends Toothless, a feared Night Fury dragon. Their unlikely bond reveals the true nature of dragons, challenging the very foundations of Viking society.

name: How to Train Your Dragon 2 - 2014
plot: Five years after uniting the dragons and Vikings of Berk, Hiccup and Toothless soar beyond their homeland, charting the vast unknown. During one of their adventures, the pair discover a secret cave that houses hundreds of wild dragons -- and a mysterious dragon rider with a startling connection to Hiccup. And as the ruthless dragon conqueror Drago Bludvist rises to seize control of both dragons and people alike, Hiccup must step into his role as a true leader and, alongside his friends and Toothless, protect Berk from a devastating war.

name: How to Train Your Dragon  The Hidden World
plot: As Hiccup fulfills his dream of creating a peaceful dragon utopia, Toothless’ discovery of an untamed, elusive mate draws the Night Fury away. When danger mounts at home and Hiccup’s reign as village chief is tested, both dragon and rider must make impossible decisions to save their kind.
